name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels, a bicycle with a motor attached and a motor scooter included; an electric two-wheeler able to exceed a moped's 50 km/h is one.

restrictions.rule: A saddle and no more than three wheels; includes motorized bicycles and motor scooters, but not mopeds
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, ss. 1(k) and 1(k.1)

restrictions.rule: Not a power-assisted bicycle, which is treated as a bicycle
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 1

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed
Riders need a driver's licence of a class covering motorcycles; an instruction permit holder rides under a licensed operator's direct supervision
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, ss. 71 and 82(3)

restrictions.rule: The rider and any passenger must wear a crash helmet meeting CSA CAN3-D230-M85, FMVSS 218, ECE 22.05, Snell M2010 or a standard the Registrar approves
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, s. 213(4)

restrictions.rule: A passenger only if it is designed to carry one, on a seat made for a passenger
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, s. 213(2)

restrictions.rule: Headlights on whenever it moves on a highway
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, s. 213(5)

restrictions.rule: Registered with the Registrar and covered by compulsory third-party insurance
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, ss. 12 and 324

restrictions.rule: An electric dirt bike designed for natural terrain is an off-highway vehicle instead
